review_evidence: README identifies Graphiti as “Formally Verified Out-of-Order Execution in Dataflow Circuits” and describes its verified rewrite engine.

A complete proposition-declaration scan found 886 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across 94 of the 148 current-primary files, including graph/module well-typedness, state transitions, rewrite correctness, liveness, deadlock, and NoC correctness.

The remaining primary files are definitions, import/API surfaces, tactics, parsers, or formal test modules supporting the same verified development; no source-local lossless exclusion class was established.
summary: Reviewed Graphiti and retain all 148 current-primary Lean files as a substantial formally verified dataflow-circuit rewriting development.

summary: Reviewed 55 Lean files in the Graphiti formal verification project. The repository contains substantial formally verified dataflow-circuit rewriting development including: circuit representations (ExprHigh/ExprLow), module semantics with input/output/internals, rewrite systems with correctness proofs, associativity list lemmas, parser implementations, and application projects (analog circuits, liveness, NoC, flushability).
